exposure: Vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) levels in amniotic fluid
cohort: The study participants were women undergoing genetic amniocentesis at 16-20 weeks' gestation, divided into a preterm delivery group (n=36) and a matched control group who delivered at term (n=36).
finding: Amniotic fluid VEGF levels in the second trimester were significantly higher in the preterm delivery group compared to the control group and were more predictive of preterm delivery than leptin levels.
gest_age: Samples collected at 16-20 weeks' gestation; preterm delivery defined as <37 weeks' gestation; control group delivered at >=37 weeks' gestation.
